name.ja: <ruby>太<rt>たい</rt></ruby><ruby>陽<rt>よう</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>処<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>刑<rt>けい</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt>にん</rt></ruby>－マキュラ

text.en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God's Destructor - Makyura" once per turn.
